name: Sarapin
description: Sarapin was a planet located in the Sarapin system in the Core Worlds. At some point prior to the attack on the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Hellion's Dare over Jiruus, a fleet battle occurred at Sarapin during which Riot Squadron members Wyl Lark and Sonogari were present, but grounded.
lead_paragraphs: Sarapin was a planet located in the Sarapin system in the Core Worlds.
